text.p: IMPORTANT NOTE: Repository size reported by the info command is now entirely based on what has written to storage. Previously, in certain cases, could detect if additional compression was being applied by the storage but this is no longer supported.

release-item.p: Retry errors in S3 batch file delete.

A failed batch delete was retried, but errors for individual files in the batch were not, and could terminate during expire or when removing a backup that could not be resumed. Files that fail in a batch are now deleted individually with the usual HTTP retries.
Allow case-insensitive matching of HTTP connection header values.
The HTTP specification allows connection header values in any case, e.g. Close.
Add support for AWS S3 server-side encryption using KMS.
Set repo-s3-kms-key-id to encrypt objects with a key managed by AWS KMS.
Add archive-missing-retry option.

By default archive-get retries a WAL segment it already reported as missing, which ignores missing notifications left in the spool path by a prior restore. With archive-missing-retry=n, can detect the end of the archive and switch to streaming even while WAL is being archived. The spool path must then be empty when recovery starts.
Add backup type filter to info command.
Set type to show only backups of that type, e.g. type=full.

commit.subject: Move command/backup-common tests in the command/backup module.
Retry on page checksum validation failure during backup.
Improve validation of zero pages.

release-item.p: Retry on page validation failure during backup.

A page that fails checksum validation is now read again. It is reported as an error only when it has not changed. A changed page is being written by , and the WAL contains a full page image. Zero pages are now checked to be all zeroes rather than only by the pd_upper field.
Handle TLS servers that do not close connections gracefully.

Some servers close the socket rather than the TLS connection. When a response has no content length or chunked encoding and its content can be parsed, the closed socket is now treated as EOF. These servers stopped working in v2.35.
Add backup LSNs to info command output.
The start and stop LSNs of a backup are shown with set and in JSON output, for use with LSN-based Point-in-Time Recovery.
Automatically strip trailing slashes for repo-ls paths.
A trailing slash on the path made repo-ls show no content on some repository storage types.

commit.subject: Improve protocol module error test for protocolClientFree().
Use normal error for protocol module error retry test.
Do not retry fatal errors.

release-item.p: Do not retry fatal errors.
Retrying fatal errors, especially out of memory errors, may cause lockups. Assertion and memory errors are now reported without retrying.
Remove support for PostgreSQL 8.3/8.4.
There is no evidence that these versions are still in use and supporting them costs development and test time. Use an older version of to back up or migrate from these versions.
Remove logic that tried to determine additional file system compression.

After a file was copied, checked its size on disk to detect compression by the file system, e.g. ZFS. This was untested, slow with many small files, and blocked file bundling. The repository size in info is now what wrote.

Add aliveness check to systemd service configuration.
The pgbackrest.service example now checks that the server is still running shortly after it starts. Before, a server that failed to start reported no error while systemd retried in the background.
Add FAQ explaining WAL archive suffix.
The suffix on a WAL file in the repository is its SHA1 checksum, which is used to verify the file. It cannot be omitted.
